name: school-carpool-functions
description: Cloud Functions (2nd gen, TypeScript) for the School Carpool app

scripts.seed:emulator: npm run build && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-school-carpool node lib/scripts/seed.js
scripts.review:emulator: npm run build && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIREBASE_STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-school-carpool node lib/scripts/review.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-school-carpool
